title: A Tribute to Dr Rolf “Buzz” Behrents (1947-2026)
html: An outstanding leader in orthodontics and craniofacial biology passed away on April 25, 2026, at the age of 78 years. Dr Rolf Gordon Behrents was an important figure in orthodontics for over 50 years, with contributions as an orthodontic educator, administrator, researcher, author, and worldwide lecturer. As a testament to his leadership as an educator in orthodontics, Dr Behrents chaired 4 orthodontic programs during his career, leaving his mark on each one. His final responsibility was a 13-year stint as the Editor-in-Chief of the American Journal of Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics (AJO-DO), considered by many to be the finest orthodontic journal in the world.
